LicenseDefinitionCustomPermission.name: LicenseDefinitionCustomPermission
LicenseDefinitionCustomPermission.description: Represents a licensed custom permission that controls access to a license's features when included in a custom permission set license definition.

CreatedById.description: ID of the User who created this record.

CreatedDate.description: Date and time when this record was created.

IsDeleted.description: When true, the record has been deleted.

LastModifiedById.description: ID of the User who last updated this record.

LastModifiedDate.description: Date and time when a user last modified this record.

LicenseDefinitionId.description: ID of the custom permission set license definition that contains the licensed custom permission.

LicensedCustomPermissionId.description: ID of the licensed custom permission that you're including in the permission set license definition. On the CustomPermission object, the isLicensed field must equal true.

SystemModstamp.description: In general, SystemModstamp shows the date and time when a user or automated process last modified the record. However, in certain cases, SystemModstamp doesn’t capture every field change. For example, if object A retrieves values from object B, then the changes to field values in records on object B are reflected in the SystemModstamp field for records on object B, but not on object A.
